title: Saul Meets Samuel

questions.question: What tribe was Saul from?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:1 (ESV): “There was a man of Benjamin whose name was Kish...”

questions.question: Why did Saul go looking for his father’s donkeys?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:3 (ESV): “Now the donkeys of Kish... were lost...”

questions.question: Who suggested Saul consult the man of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:6 (ESV): “But he said to him, ‘Behold, there is a man of God in this city...’”

questions.question: What did God tell Samuel about Saul?
options: He would be king over Israel
questions.correctAnswer: He would be king over Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:16 (ESV): “...you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel...”

questions.question: What did Samuel give Saul at the feast?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:23-24 (ESV): “...‘Bring the portion I gave you...’...’”

questions.question: Who was Saul's father?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:1 (ESV): "There was a man of Benjamin whose name was Kish..."

questions.question: What was Saul's physical appearance?
options: Handsome and taller than any of the people
questions.correctAnswer: Handsome and taller than any of the people
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:2 (ESV): "...a handsome young man. ...From his shoulders upward he was taller than any of the people."

questions.question: What term was formerly used in Israel for a prophet?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:9 (ESV): "...for he who is now called a prophet was formerly called a seer."

questions.question: What gift did the servant have to give the man of God?
options: A quarter of a shekel of silver
questions.correctAnswer: A quarter of a shekel of silver
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:8 (ESV): "...I have here in my hand a quarter of a shekel of silver..."

questions.question: Where did Samuel meet Saul?
options: In the gate / on the way to the high place
questions.correctAnswer: In the gate / on the way to the high place
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:18 (ESV): "Then Saul approached Samuel in the gate..."

questions.question: What did Samuel tell Saul about the donkeys before Saul asked?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:20 (ESV): "As for your donkeys that were lost three days ago, do not set your mind on them, for they have been found."

questions.question: What specific portion of meat did the cook set before Saul?
options: The leg and what was on it
questions.correctAnswer: The leg and what was on it
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:24 (ESV): "So the cook took up the leg and what was on it and set them before Saul."

questions.question: Where did Saul sleep?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:25-26 (ESV): "...he spoke with Saul on the roof... Samuel called to Saul on the roof..."

questions.question: Samuel told Saul, "And for whom is all that is desirable in Israel? Is it not for you and ______?"
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:20 (ESV): "...Is it not for you and for all your father's house?"

questions.question: How many men did Samuel invite to the feast?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:22 (ESV): "...and gave them a place at the head of those who had been invited, who were about thirty persons."

key_verse_text: Tomorrow about this time I will send to you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. (ESV)
